newsitem.title: USA: Panax extends acquisition date to Oct. 1.
newsitem.headline: Panax extends acquisition date to Oct. 1.

text.p: Panax Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said Thursday it agreed to extend to October 31 the date by which it is tol complete its acquisition of CorBec Pharmaceuticals Inc.
Panax said the previously-announced acquisition and the related financing cannot be concluded without an increase in the number of authorized shares of its common stock.
The company said the acquisition is subject to its receipt of financing of at least $8 million upon or before the consummation of the deal.

Panax said it plans to schedule a special meeting of its shareholders to be held on or before October 31 to consider an amendment that would increase its authorized shares of common stock to 50 million from 10 million.
The amendment will also provide for a change in the corporate name to InKine Pharmaceutical Co Inc and an authorization of a class of five million shares of preferred stock.
